verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs show event-driven automation in the email context: workflows can automate actions after an email is sent, and RSS/blog emails send automatically when new content is published. The evidence is thin and limited to email-adjacent triggers; it says nothing about general rule definition, trigger types, conditions, or branching. Missing for 10: documentation of a general workflow/rules engine with configurable event triggers and conditions, breadth of supported events and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can set up simple workflows to automate actions after the email is sent.
This email will be sent automatically when you publish new content to your blog or RSS feed.
